question_en: According to F-30.03, what occurs before setting internal address variables?
explanation_en: F-30.03 lists mapping inputs and outputs before setting address variables.
explanation_es: F-30.03 lista mapear entradas y salidas antes de establecer variables de dirección.

question_en: What must be done with F-30.03 program changes?
options: Back them up and document them according to facility policy.
explanation_en: F-30.03 requires program changes to be backed up and documented.
explanation_es: F-30.03 exige respaldar y documentar los cambios del programa.

question_en: Which item is listed as an automated-control program variable?
explanation_en: Counters are listed among automated-control program variables.
explanation_es: Los contadores están listados entre las variables de programas de control automatizado.
